question: Which dynasty ruled after the Tuglaq dynasty?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sayyid dynasty**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Sayyid dynasty was founded by Khizr Khan who claimed to be a descendant of Prophet Muhammad.
 
• It ruled the Delhi Sultanate from 1414 to 1451.
 
• The Sayyid dynasty succeeded the Tughlaq dynasty and preceded the Lodi dynasty.
 
• During the Sayyid rule, the Delhi Sultanate faced numerous internal and external challenges, including invasions and internal revolts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tughlaq dynasty**

 
 
• The Tughlaq dynasty ruled the Delhi Sultanate from 1320 to 1413.
 
• Founded by Ghiyath al-Din Tughlaq, it is known for its administrative reforms and architectural achievements, including the fort of Tughlaqabad in Delhi.
 
• The most notable ruler was Muhammad bin Tughlaq, known for his ambitious but often impractical policies, including the transfer of the capital from Delhi to Daulatabad.
 
• Despite its initial success, the dynasty faced severe challenges, including revolts and invasions, leading to its eventual decline.
 
 
 
• **Lodi dynasty**
 
 
• The Lodi dynasty was the last dynasty of the Delhi Sultanate, ruling from 1451 to 1526.
 
• Founded by Bahlul Lodi, it was a Pashtun dynasty and marked the beginning of Afghan rule in India.
 
• The most notable ruler was Sikandar Lodi, who expanded the territory and improved administrative efficiency.
 
• The dynasty ended with the defeat of Ibrahim Lodi by Babur in the Battle of Panipat in 1526, leading to the establishment of the Mughal Empire.
 
 
 
• **Khalji dynasty**
 
 
• The Khalji dynasty ruled the Delhi Sultanate from 1290 to 1320.
 
• Founded by Jalal-ud-din Khalji, it is known for its military campaigns and expansion of the Sultanate's territory.
 
• Alauddin Khalji, the most prominent ruler, implemented significant economic and administrative reforms and successfully defended the Sultanate against Mongol invasions.
 
• The dynasty came to an end with the assassination of the last Khalji ruler, Qutb-ud-din Mubarak Shah, by his own nobles.
 
 
 
• **Mamluk dynasty**
 
 
• The Mamluk dynasty, also known as the Slave dynasty, ruled the Delhi Sultanate from 1206 to 1290.
 
• It was founded by Qutb-ud-din Aibak, a former slave of Muhammad of Ghor, who became the first Sultan of Delhi.
 
• The dynasty is known for its architectural contributions, including the construction of the Qutb Minar.
 
• The Mamluk dynasty ended with the rise of the Khalji dynasty in 1290.
